authority_order: current explicit teacher instruction for the specific job
current Curriculum Philosophy plus declared current philosophy amendments
current Algebra Framework front door plus current Framework amendment, this authority contract, and declared current course policy/source-map files
exact embedded Unit Assessment Plan for exact learning content
current executable task PM for procedure
assessment_plan_rule: Exact Unit Assessment Plan HTML owns Unit learning content. Legacy Exit Ticket/Portfolio wording embedded in older plans does not override current Portfolio/Quick Check policy.
quick_check_rule: Quick Check is the current common short-evidence artifact. Curriculum defines predictable slots; live Portfolio state selects just-in-time reassessment targets; teacher approves actual questions.
source_mapping_rule: For a known recurring source, use a declared current source map before judging responses. Map by clean task/evidence job rather than shuffled question number. A genuinely dual-target task may yield separate target judgments while remaining one assessment opportunity.
portfolio_status_rule: I Can status uses No Evidence / Developing / Mastered / Transfer. Algebra Mastery Goal is demonstrated when at least 2 of 4 I Cans are Mastered or Transfer. Unit status uses I/C/B/A/A+.
independence_rule: Mastered normally requires at least two independent convincing demonstrations, usually from different opportunities. Same-paper repeated items are not automatically independent.
bank_rule: Canonical Algebra Bank is Mastery Goal -> I Can -> family architecture with technical unitN.html and student.html. MG, I Can, and family IDs are permanent fragment anchors. Student deep links must visibly identify the targeted family on desktop and mobile.
portfolio_template_rule: Tools/templates/portfolio/PORTFOLIO_TEMPLATE_CONTRACT.json plus registered student/teacher HTML/CSS own recurring report structure AND fixed recurring wording. PM/data fill slots; ad hoc redesign/rephrasing is not allowed.
task_pm_rule: Task PM owns procedure and delivery. Framework/policy owns Algebra evidence behavior. PMs may not revive retired Exit Ticket mechanics or invent alternate Portfolio report structures.
student_next_action_rule: Current policy/template own the stable student next-action layer. Proficiency status and next action are distinct; Developing may route to Practice + check soon or Needs another independent check based on current evidence.
